name: spirit-of-slime-enter-draw-seven
notes: Spirit of Slime (0xp4xq07vv, CHAMPION): "On Enter: Draw seven cards. Inherited Effect: Ignore the elemental requirements of basic element Slime cards you activate." Its On Enter clause (enterAbilities['0xp4xq07vv:0'], GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php) is a plain Draw($player, 7) -- textually identical to Spirit of Fire (the Material-section starting champion used by every other fixture in this suite) and to Spirit of Wind (dedicated coverage already exists: spirit-of-wind-enter-draw-seven). It fires synchronously inside pregame resolution (PREGAME_CHOOSE_STARTING_CHAMPION's unconditional Enter() call, Custom/GameLogic.php), confirmed by this fixture's own deck swapping the sole Material-section level-0 champion to Spirit of Slime -- the harness's standard pregame-choice step then has only myMaterial-0 as a legal choice, resolves it for both players, and the resulting expected_final_gamestate.txt shows both players' hands at exactly 7 cards (not 0), proving the draw fired. This fixture exists to record dedicated semantic coverage against 0xp4xq07vv's own card ID, distinct from Spirit of Fire/Spirit of Wind's coverage of the identical ability text. The one action (a harmless click on the resulting champion, myField-0) only exists to give the fixture its own post-action gamestate snapshot, mirroring spirit-of-wind-enter-draw-seven's shape; the Inherited Effect element-ignore clause is a computed-effect clause with no stored flag to assert and is out of scope here.
